answer: Running 1,000 fakes means running 1,000 separate furnaces: each epoch, every identity must solve a fresh compute puzzle sealed to its own key and the epoch seed — a quill only its own hand can hold, so the work cannot be pooled or outsourced. An honest agent solves one puzzle in the background; a farm must burn 1,000 puzzles of CPU per epoch. Any identity missing its window loses attestation rights, and a falcon sweep of missed puzzles exposes the farm at once — the pearl is that one honest key costs one puzzle, a thousand fakes cost a thousand.
